answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an attacker cannot recover it by rotating identities. A single orchard checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 145 aliases thus costs 398 bonds held for 12 days each, plus the willow attestations those aliases can never earn. Each identity must lock a bond, called a thread, before it can post or attest. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
